Amazon IVS Low-Latency Streaming now provides a failover slate
changes.detail: Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) Low-Latency Streaming now provides a failover slate, an animated image that IVS displays to viewers when a broadcaster's stream is unexpectedly interrupted. Instead of a buffering wheel or frozen frame, viewers see the slate until the broadcaster reconnects. Live playback then resumes automatically, without viewers needing to refresh their player. The failover slate helps you retain your audience during momentary disruptions and is ideal for broadcasters streaming from mobile devices or from locations with unreliable connectivity. changes.title: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to use flow modules in agentic CX designer
changes.detail: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to use flow modules as data requests in agentic CX designer, so you can build and apply reusable logic across your customer experience flows. You can run a flow module at a fixed step in a conversation with a Data request node, or give it to a Generative journey as a tool to call when the conversation needs it. With this launch, you can use flow modules to update customer profiles and cases, create tasks, look up data tables, send an SMS confirmation, or check hours of operation and staffing before escalating to a human agent.
